body:
M5 compares A (M1 token sequence) and C (bijectively flattened M2 IDs) through the same 14,681,984-parameter flat causal Transformer, using the frozen corpus-v2, artifacts, optimizer and seed protocol. The historical Rust 1.85 workspace remains CUDA-free. This draft continues the existing stacked PR against `m4-factorization-ablation`.

The initial NVIDIA L4 attempt exited 127 in the ELF loader before Rust started and was released; its original logs and resource accounting remain preserved. Recovery reuses the unchanged 456,605,722-byte bundle v4 and fourteen verified transfer parts, adding independent loader diagnostics, bounded local supervision, authoritative remote-exit/PASS validation, and immutable Drive copy/full-download/SHA-256 completion manifests. Full training and additional allocations remain locked.

Validation: root Rust 1.85 formatting, strict Clippy, 135 tests and release build; isolated M5 formatting, strict CPU/CUDA-feature Clippy on local CPU, 18 Rust CPU tests and the weight-recovery example release build; 18 CPU lifecycle/storage regressions plus original transfer/lifecycle mocks. All v4 archive/input/source/executable hashes, CPU loader/reference and prepared input identities pass. No scientific model source, configuration, corpus, tokenizer, mapping or historical artifact changed during recovery.

Current blocker: browser OAuth completed, but the real WSL Drive namespace setup hit HTTP 403 `rateLimitExceeded` for rclone's shared OAuth project before upload/download integrity verification. A user-created Desktop client is pending. The user requires a successful independent WSL Drive fixture before allocation, so this recovery task has allocated zero GPUs and consumed none of its one authorized 30-minute L4 preflight. CUDA correctness, gradients, optimizer updates, overfit, timings, VRAM and persistent weight recovery are still unmeasured. Weights-only safetensors do not provide exact optimizer/training resume; long runs require complete resumable checkpoints and separate measured budget approval.

Evidence and protocol: [M5 design](https://github.com/DasEtwa/PackTok/blob/m5-gpu-transformer/M5_GPU_TRANSFORMER.md), [M5 accounting](https://github.com/DasEtwa/PackTok/blob/m5-gpu-transformer/M5_GPU_BENCHMARK.md), [recovery/storage record](https://github.com/DasEtwa/PackTok/blob/m5-gpu-transformer/experiments/m5-gpu/provenance/RECOVERY_STORAGE.md), and [preserved CPU/resource logs](https://github.com/DasEtwa/PackTok/tree/m5-gpu-transformer/experiments/m5-gpu/provenance/recovery-20261008).

Operational state: `M5_BLOCKED — INFRASTRUCTURE`. No preflight or full M5 research signal is claimed.
title: M5: CPU-validated Transformer preparation and bounded L4 preflight
